subject: Proposal: Operational confidence package & renewal terms for Valor Bank
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@valorbank.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: ops@valorbank.com
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recent latency spikes and renewal window

Mina —

Thanks for the quick check-in last week. We had another incident this past Friday (05/08) where tail latency on our core payments endpoint spiked to ~2.4s for ~18 minutes during peak. That caused a handful of failed retries and a visible hit to throughput for a narrow time window.

Our renewals committee is meeting next week and we need to evaluate whether we can proceed with the current SOW/renewal or whether we require an elevated SLA plus remediation commitments. This is partly about availability but mostly about consistent tail latency — it’s impacting customer-facing SLAs.

Can you outline what short-term mitigations you can offer (credits, runbook changes, dedicated capacity options) and what a premium reliability path would look like (SLOs, pricing uplift, migration timeline)? We’re hoping to get a written proposal by the 15th if possible.

Appreciate any immediate remediation you can do.

—Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Platform Reliability
Valor Bank


From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@valorbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-10T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recent latency spikes and renewal window

Hi Priya —

First, I’m really sorry about the Friday spike. I know this impacts your ops and revenue. We pulled the incident runbook and a short summary is attached (incident-summary-0508.pdf). High level: a batch job on a neighboring tenant spilled into a shared host during a scheduled migration window; our auto-isolate logic took ~6 minutes to fully rebalance, which is when tail latency peaked.

Immediate mitigations we can offer this week:
- One-time service credit equivalent to 10% of April usage for the impacted service (applied to the next invoice).
- Temporary capacity isolation for your payments namespace for 72 hours to validate stability (no config changes required from you).
- A joint postmortem workshop with our infra and your SREs this week to align guardrails.

Longer-term premium path (what I’ll formalize in the proposal):
- Guaranteed 99.95% availability and 95th/99th token latency targets for your critical routes, backed by an SLA addendum.
- Dedicated shard pools with a 20% uplift in committed capacity (reduces noisy-neighbor risk).
- Quarterly reliability reviews + a priority on-call channel and 24/7 escalation for incidents affecting agreed endpoints.

I’ll draft a concise commercial proposal with pricing and the service addendum and aim to send by 05/15 so your committee can review. Would a quick 30-minute alignment call on Monday (05/11) work?

Warmly,
Mina Haddad
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

(attachment: incident-summary-0508.pdf)

From: Lucas Reed <l.reed@valorbank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@valorbank.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recent latency spikes and renewal window

Mina/Team —

Thanks for the quick reply. Monday 05/11 at 10:00 PT works for Priya and me. Agenda: 1) confirm the root cause and immediate mitigations, 2) walk the premium package outline and pricing, 3) deliverable dates for remediation and SLA addendum.

We'll invite our cloud procurement lead as well — I’ll forward the calendar invite.

Best,
Lucas
Director, Cloud Operations
Valor Bank

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-12T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Valor - premium reliability ask (internal)

Team —

Forwarding Priya's note and the ask from Valor. They want a written proposal by 05/15 that includes: short-term credits, a premium SLA addendum (99.95% availability + 99th token latency target), and a priced option for dedicated shard pools.

Prelim commercial thinking (ballpark):
- SLA addendum baseline: +12% list price across impacted routes (committed 12-month term) OR
- Dedicated shard pilot: 3-month pilot at +18% committed fee, then recontract at +14% if onboarded.
- We eat the one-time investigative time; customer-facing credit as Mina proposed (10% April).

Questions/asks:
- Marcus: do we have capacity headroom to promise a 3-month dedicated pilot starting within 10 business days?
- Ben: how should we structure the credit and SLO penalties in the addendum so this doesn’t set a wide precedent?
- Grace: can we include a clause for automatic fallback to the existing tier if targets aren’t met after pilot?

Please reply with redlines by EOD 05/13. I’ll assemble a customer-facing package after.

Thanks — Mina

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@valorbank.com>, Lucas Reed <l.reed@valorbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-15T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Valor: Operational Confidence proposal and service addendum (proposal attached)

Priya/Lucas —

Following our call and the internal reviews, please find a concise package attached: Valor-premium-proposal.pdf and a draft service addendum (service-addendum-draft.docx). Highlights:

1) Short-term remediation
- One-time credit: 10% of April invoice applied to next invoice (covers immediate disruption).
- 72-hour capacity isolation window scheduled for 05/17 to validate changes.

2) Operational Confidence Package (commercial)
- SLA addendum: 99.95% monthly uptime for payments routes; measurable 95th/99th token latency targets with defined measurement window.
- Commitment: 12-month term; price uplift +13% over current committed rate.
- Dedicated pilot: optional 90-day dedicated shard pilot at +17% (creditable against annual commitment if converted within 90 days).
- Escalation & ops: prioritized incident triage, quarterly reliability reviews, two on-site/virtual workshops per year.

3) Acceptance and timelines
- If Valor confirms by 05/18 we’ll provision the pilot environment and send a DocuSign link for the addendum. Target pilot start: 05/24.

Please review the attachments and let me know any contract redlines. I’m happy to route this through our legal/procurement contacts if useful; otherwise I can prepare the DocuSign for signature once you confirm.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

(attachments: valor-premium-proposal.pdf, service-addendum-draft.docx)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@valorbank.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Lucas Reed <l.reed@valorbank.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Valor: Operational Confidence proposal and service addendum (proposal attached)

Mina —

Thanks for the clear package and the goodwill credit. Valor’s committee reviewed and we’re ready to proceed with the Operational Confidence Package as written. We prefer to start with the 90-day dedicated pilot and convert to the 12-month commitment if the pilot meets our performance gates. Please send the DocuSign for the addendum and the pilot provisioning checklist.

One note for the legal team: we will request a limited liability cap adjustment specific to incidents tied to noisy-neighbor escape behaviors — I’ll mark that in redline but it shouldn’t block provisioning.

Confirmed acceptance deadline: 05/18 — approved.

Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Platform Reliability
Valor Bank
